task_message:
Case M37: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 350x350x220 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary of what I did:**
1. **Located the lesion** with `seg_open` and contact sheets in all three planes — a large, elongated, T2-hyperintense lobulated mass in the soft tissues of the limb (fat-suppressed T2, so bright = lesion/fluid, dark = fat/muscle).
2. **Initial prompt** with a positive point on an edge mark inside the mass produced v1 (112.9 mL), spanning axial 98–219 × coronal 163–211 × sagittal 162–213.
3. **Verified boundaries** in axial, coronal and sagittal zooms — the outline hugs the mass capsule, and the candidate detector found no missed lesion tissue.
4. **Tested an inferior extension** (v2) along a bright fascial line; zoomed inspection at the lower levels showed the mask degenerating into a thin rim around non-tumoral tissue, so I reverted to v1.
5. **Final review** (5 slices/plane) confirmed the mask covers the whole hyperintense mass with clean ends and no significant stray components; saved with **medium** confidence (adjacent cystic/bursal fluid at the superior pole and the thin inferior fascial tail were deliberately excluded as separate structures).
